==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
The sky is the same as it was in yesterday night's dream. It glows and shimmers with a myriad of colors like a kaleidescope. Unlike yesterday night's dream, there aren't any elf gods present.

Instead I am alone with a computer on a floating island of stone. The computer is running the Deep Seek large language model. I decide that I should use it to try to trigger a spiritual experience.

I create a choose your own adventure game using Deep Seek. The game is about superpowered alien warriors and their connection to the divine realm. It seems odd to create a game about exploring the realm, instead of just actually exploring the realm.

I wake up and begin contemplating the nature of spiritual experiences with my eyes closed. I feel my body start to undergo sleep paralysis. I see a skinny, gray, bald, alien figure with large black eyes surrounded by an aura of blue light.

The figure's blue light envelopes me with a sense of peace as if it is scanning me. I consider asking it a question, but I feel as if I don't have to. I open my eyes and I feel rejuvenated.
